1) Tight, two-liner
Subject: Monday exec sync
Hi [Name], I have a scheduling conflict on Monday and won’t be able to join the exec sync—please proceed without me. I’ll catch up on any decisions afterward. —[Your Name]

2) Warmer, offers notes
Subject: Monday exec sync — unable to attend
Hi [Name], I’m tied up with an urgent commitment and won’t be able to make the exec sync on Monday—sorry to miss it. If it helps, I can send a brief update/notes beforehand or a short summary after the meeting to cover my items. —[Your Name]
